title: Diluted Oil of Sharpness

sources.title: Coatings
markers: | description = A subset of Potions, Coatings can apply a variety of harmful effects to weapons that aid in combat for a short period of time.

sources.role: Rules: Coated in Diluted Oil of Sharpness
sources.title: Coated in Diluted Oil of Sharpness

summary: Spend one dose as a Bonus Action to coat the active weapon set for 10 turns.

fields.Effect: The coating gives +1 to attack and damage and makes the weapon magical. Dual wielding coats both weapons in the active set. Coat the other weapon set separately. Dipping and coating are mutually exclusive.
fields.Throw: Throwing the bottle creates no coating area.
fields.Base value: 25 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
